title: Hexus Go 2+10 Refillable Pod Vape Kit
description: Imagine a prefilled pod kit that lets you load it with your favourite e-liquids and switch flavours whenever you like. The Hexus Go 2+10 Refillable Pod Kit is the first device of its kind to offer this level of freedom, pairing a side-fill 2ml pod with an integrated 10ml refill reservoir. This unique configuration stays fully TPD-compliant while dramatically reducing the need for frequent refilling—and removing the limits of prefilled flavours—making it a versatile and convenient option for everyday vaping. Powered by a 1000mAh internal battery, the device offers two power modes to suit your preference: Normal Mode (16W) delivers a gentler vape, while Turbo Mode (20W) provides a stronger hit. The Hexus Go also features inhale activation, a bright LCD screen, and USB-C fast charging for seamless day-to-day use. Each pod is fitted with a 0.6ohm dual mesh coil to ensure smooth, consistent vapour with both nicotine salt and freebase e-liquids. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, the device produces discreet vapour and rich flavour in a compact, pocket-friendly format that's easy to refill and recharge. Whether you're upgrading from disposables or looking for a more cost-effective and sustainable refillable device , the Hexus Go 2+10 offers a smarter, longer-lasting solution.
